                      Assigned participants by session

                      Everyone currently assigned to each session — name, age, country, and their WhatsApp-ready contact number. Export each session's list as CSV.

                      Confirmation Templates

                      Grouped by exactly which session(s) each person is assigned to. Set a confirmation message template per group below — it'll be used to pre-fill each person's WhatsApp message in the Confirmation tab. Use {{name}} where their name should go.

                      Click Send on each row to open WhatsApp with that person's confirmation message pre-filled — you just press Send inside WhatsApp. Participants are split evenly across 3 crews so multiple people can work through the list at once.

                      Attendance & Plus-1

                      Update whether each confirmed volunteer has replied to attend, and record any plus-1 they're bringing. Split into the same 3 crews as the Confirmation tab.

                      Emergency Contacts

                      Paste in one or more responses in the format below, then click Parse. Works with a single entry or many pasted together.

                      Volunteer name: ABC Emergency Contact * Name: Yap Chee Hoong * Relationship: Father * Contact Number: 016-3286497

                      Total physical headcount per session — confirmed volunteers plus any plus-1s they're bringing. Compared against your session cap (if set) so you can see if the real headcount exceeds it.
